plugins.name: 自动化任务
plugins.description: 定时/延时跑一句话任务，结果写进「自动化」会话。程序开着的时候生效。
plugins.description_en: Schedule prompts (one-shot or repeating) and collect results in an "Automation" chat while the app runs.

plugins.name: 智能压缩上下文
plugins.description: 把较早的对话压成一条摘要，腾出上下文空间；摘要由模型自己写，插件负责安全地改历史。
plugins.description_en: Replace early history with one summary to free context; the model writes the summary, the plugin rewrites history safely.

plugins.name: 操作电脑
plugins.description: 移动鼠标、点击、输入文字、按键、列出并切换窗口。危险：会给模型操作桌面的能力。
plugins.description_en: Move the mouse, click, type text, press keys, list and focus windows. Dangerous: gives the model control over your desktop.

plugins.name: 上下文洞察
plugins.description: 看一眼当前对话有多大：消息数、字数、估算 token、还能塞多少；以及把早期历史压成摘要。
plugins.description_en: Inspect the current conversation size (messages, chars, estimated tokens, headroom) and compress early history into a summary.

plugins.name: 记忆系统
plugins.description: 长期记忆：把用户偏好、事实记下来，需要时按关键词检索。存在本地 user:// 里，不上传。
plugins.description_en: Long-term memory: store facts, recall by keyword, local only.

plugins.name: OAR 智能体
plugins.description: 把任务交给本机装的外部智能体命令行（codex / claude / ollama / llm…），拿回它的输出。
plugins.description_en: Delegate a task to an external agent CLI installed on this machine (codex / claude / ollama / llm …) and return its output.

plugins.name: 远程操作
plugins.description: 把本机变成一个任务端点（HTTP），或者把任务发给另一台开着 Local-Harness 的机器。
plugins.description_en: Expose this machine as an HTTP task endpoint, or send tasks to another machine running Local-Harness.

plugins.name: 截图
plugins.description: 抓一张全屏截图存成 PNG，返回路径和分辨率（配合识图插件可以看图）。
plugins.description_en: Capture a full-screen PNG and return its path and resolution (works with the vision plugin to read it).

plugins.name: 子智能体
plugins.description: 另起一个独立的模型实例，带着自己的系统提示去处理子任务，只把结果交回来。
plugins.description_en: Spawn a separate model instance with its own system prompt for a subtask, returning only the result.

plugins.name: 终端
plugins.description: 在 Windows 上执行命令，把标准输出和退出码返回给模型。带危险命令黑名单。
plugins.description_en: Run commands on Windows and return output, with a dangerous-command denylist.

plugins.name: 识图
plugins.description: 看图：读取图片信息、用系统 OCR 提取文字；如果配了视觉模型（GGUF + mmproj）就直接描述画面。
plugins.description_en: Image understanding: read image info, extract text with system OCR, or describe the picture when a vision GGUF + mmproj is configured.

plugins.name: 语音输入
plugins.description: 朗读回答（Windows 中文语音）；也能录一段麦克风并尝试用系统语音识别转成文字。
plugins.description_en: Speak answers aloud (Windows voices) and record the mic, transcribing it with the system speech recognizer when available.

plugins.name: 网页搜索与获取
plugins.description: 抓取网页正文（curl 转纯文本）和 DuckDuckGo 关键词搜索，把结果喂给模型。
plugins.description_en: Fetch page text and search DuckDuckGo.
